blocks.text: עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יְמִינֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן תּוֹרָתֶךָ. לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ. הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי:
uncertainties: The page starts partway through the Elohai netzor paragraph, which begins on the earlier scan. Join it to the end of s123.
תּוֹרָתֶךָ: I can't confirm the dagesh in the first ת at this scan resolution.
הוֹשִׁיעָה: there may be a small meteg or accent mark near the ש. I didn't record one.

blocks.text: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי־פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ צוּרִי וְגֹאֲלִי:
uncertainties: Psalms 19:15. There is no printed citation and no cantillation on the page. The divine name is printed as יְיָ.

blocks.text: עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:

יְהִי רָצוֹן לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ שֶׁיִּבָּנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ: וְשָׁם נַעֲבָדְךָ בְּיִרְאָה כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמֹנִיּוֹת:
uncertainties: This paragraph is set in a smaller font.
בְיָמֵינוּ: I can't tell whether the ב has a dagesh. I read it as rafe (no dagesh).

blocks.text: וְעָרְבָה לַייָ מִנְחַת יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלָםִ כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמֹנִיּוֹת:
uncertainties: Malachi 3:4. There is no printed citation and no cantillation.
לַייָ: I can't tell whether there is a sheva under the first yod (לַיְיָ). Check against the full page.
וִירוּשָׁלָםִ: I can't confirm the hiriq between the lamed and the final mem. It may be absent (וִירוּשָׁלָם).
The final sof-pasuq looks like a heavier ׃/: glyph than the others on the page. Treat it as an ordinary colon.

blocks.text: me, speedily frustrate their counsel and upset their plan. Do this for the sake of Thy Name, do this for the sake of Thy right hand, do this for the sake of Thy holiness, do this for the sake of Thy Torah so that those who love Thee may be delivered. Save with Thy right hand and respond to me. May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart find favour before Thee, O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer. May He who makes peace in His heights, make peace for us and for all Israel, and say, Amen.
uncertainties: The page starts partway through a sentence ("me, speedily…") that continues from the previous English scan, s123. Join the two.

blocks.text: May it find favour before Thee, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, that the sanctuary be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant our portion in Thy Torah. There we will serve Thee in awe as in the days of old and former years. And pleasant unto the Lord shall be the offering of Judah and Jerusalem as in the days of old and former years.
uncertainties: This paragraph is set in a smaller font.
pleasant: the 'n' is badly printed and looks like 'pleasaıt'. This is damaged type, not a spelling variant.
